evidence.quote: We open at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays

observations.why: Habitual present describing a recurring weekly pattern (Tuesdays and Thursdays), so attention is on the present schedule at a pattern level; the explicit modal 'can' suspends the realis sub-axis, so modality is omitted.

evidence.quote: we close an hour earlier those days

observations.why: Present-tense recurring practice ('those days') framed by a general staffing principle; focus is the standing current arrangement and construal is the pattern rather than a single event.
